units.source_text: 不久太阳出来，照着檐前的冰箸，发出晶莹的光辉。

en.t: Before long the sun came out, shining on the icicles before the eaves and giving off a clear, sparkling light.

units.source_text: 浮舟的容颜映着这光辉，越发娇艳可爱。

en.t: Ukifune's face was lit by that radiance and looked all the more charming and lovely.

units.source_text: 匂亲王微行而来，身上服装十分轻便。

en.t: Prince Niou had come in secret, dressed very lightly and simply.

units.source_text: 浮舟也因就睡时已卸装，此时只穿衬衣，娇小玲珑，丰姿更美。

en.t: Ukifune too had undressed when she went to sleep, and now wore only underclothes, making her small, delicate figure seem even more beautiful.

units.source_text: 她自念毫无修饰，随意不拘的姿态对着这清丽无比的美少年，非常羞耻。

en.t: Thinking how unadorned and informal she looked before this incomparably graceful young man, she felt deeply ashamed.

units.source_text: 然而无法隐避。

en.t: Yet there was no way for her to hide.

units.source_text: 她身穿白色的家常内衣五件，连袖口和衣裾上都流露出娇艳之色，反比五色灿烂的盛妆更美。

en.t: She wore five layers of plain white underrobes, and even the cuffs and hems showed a tender beauty lovelier than splendid formal dress in five bright colors.

units.source_text: 匂亲王在常见的两位夫人身上，从来不曾看到过如此随意不拘的姿态，今天看见浮舟这样打扮，反而觉得新颖可喜。

en.t: Prince Niou had never seen such an easy, unguarded manner in the two ladies he usually visited, so seeing Ukifune dressed this way felt fresh and delightful to him.

units.source_text: 侍从也是个丰姿翘楚的青年侍女。

en.t: Jiju too was a young gentlewoman of exceptional grace and beauty.

units.source_text: 浮舟想起自己这种行径不仅右近知道，这侍女也全般看到了，颇觉难以为情。

en.t: Ukifune remembered that not only Ukon but also this gentlewoman had seen the whole affair, and she felt quite embarrassed.

units.source_text: 匂亲王对侍从说：“你又是谁？

en.t: Prince Niou said to Jiju, "And who are you?

units.source_text: 你不可把我的名字告诉人啊！”

en.t: You must not tell anyone my name!"

units.source_text: 侍从觉得这位亲王风度实甚优美。

en.t: Jiju thought that this prince's manner was truly elegant.

units.source_text: 这别庄的管理人把时方看作主人，殷勤招待。

en.t: The steward of the villa took Tokikata for the master and received him with great courtesy.

units.source_text: 时方所住的房间和匂亲王的住处只隔一扇拉门，他住在那里得意扬扬。

en.t: Tokikata's room was separated from Prince Niou's lodging by only one sliding door, and he stayed there feeling very pleased with himself.

units.source_text: 管理人非常尊敬他，低声下气地说话。

en.t: The steward showed him great respect and spoke in a humble, deferential voice.

units.source_text: 时方看见他不识亲王而只认主人，觉得可笑，并不和他答话。

en.t: Tokikata found it amusing that the man did not recognize the prince and acknowledged only him as master, so he did not answer him.

units.source_text: 后来吩咐他：“据阴阳师占卜，我这几天有可怕的禁忌，京中也不可居住，所以到这里避凶。

en.t: Later he instructed him, "According to the diviner's reading, I am under a fearful taboo for these few days and cannot stay in the capital, so I have come here to avoid misfortune.

units.source_text: 你不可让外人走近我来。”

en.t: You must not let any outsiders come near me."

units.source_text: 于是匂亲王和浮舟放心地欢叙了一天，绝无人来打扰。

en.t: Thus Prince Niou and Ukifune spent the whole day talking happily at ease, with no one coming to disturb them.

units.source_text: 匂亲王推想薰大将来时浮舟是否也这样地对待他，便觉妒火中烧。

en.t: Prince Niou imagined whether Ukifune treated Captain Kaoru this way when he came, and jealousy burned fiercely within him.

units.source_text: 他就把薰大将如何重视并宠爱二公主的情形讲给浮舟听。

en.t: He then told Ukifune how highly Captain Kaoru valued and cherished the Second Princess.

units.source_text: 而关于薰大将吟诵古歌“绣床铺只袖”之事，则绝不谈起。

en.t: But he said nothing at all about Captain Kaoru having recited the old poem, "spreading only one sleeve on an embroidered bed."

units.source_text: 其居心也可谓不良了。

en.t: His intentions could hardly be called honorable.

units.source_text: 时方派人送进盥洗具及果物来。

en.t: Tokikata sent someone in with washing utensils and fruit.

units.source_text: 匂亲王同他开玩笑：“如此尊贵的客人，不该当这种下贱的差使！”

en.t: Prince Niou joked with him, "Such an honored guest should not be doing such lowly errands!"

units.source_text: 侍从是个多情的青年女子，爱慕这时方大夫，和他相对晤谈，直到日暮。

en.t: Jiju was a passionate young woman who admired this gentleman Tokikata, and she sat facing him in conversation until dusk.

units.source_text: 匂亲王在雪景中遥望浮舟原来的住处，但见云霞断续之间露出几处树梢。

en.t: Prince Niou gazed through the snowy landscape toward Ukifune's former dwelling, but could see only a few treetops appearing through breaks in the clouds and haze.

units.source_text: 雪山映着夕阳，像挂着的镜子一般闪闪发光。

en.t: The snowy mountains reflected the evening sun and glittered like hanging mirrors.

units.source_text: 他就把昨夜来时一路艰险的情况讲给浮舟听，加以夸张，动人听闻。

en.t: He told Ukifune about the hardships of the road he had taken the previous night, exaggerating them in a way that stirred the listener's heart.

units.source_text: 遂吟诗曰：

en.t: Then he recited a poem:
